name: Nukli Chat
author: nukli

sections.description:
Nukli Chat adds a chat bubble to your store. The assistant answers questions about your products (sizes, colours, stock, prices, discounts) and your policies (shipping, returns), using your WooCommerce catalog as the source. The plugin is translated into Spanish, Catalan, French, German, Italian and Portuguese. Customers can also ask where their order is: they give the order number and the email used to buy, and the assistant replies with the status and the tracking link.

External service

This plugin connects to Nukli (https://nukliapp.com), a paid external service. Nothing is sent until you paste the keys of your Nukli site in Settings › Nukli Chat.

  • The chat widget is loaded from the Nukli address you configure (by default https://chat.nukliapp.com). Your visitors’ messages are processed by Nukli.
  • Nukli’s server reads your public catalog and pages through signed endpoints added by this plugin (/wp-json/nuklichat/v1/…). Only requests signed with your site secret are answered.
  • Order lookups: when a visitor asks about an order in the chat, Nukli sends the order number and the email the visitor typed to your store (signed endpoint /wp-json/nuklichat/v1/order). The store answers only if both match an order, and only with the order number, date, status, total, product names and quantities, and shipment tracking (carrier, tracking number and link). Addresses, phone numbers, names and payment details are never sent.
  • Order actions from the support inbox (0.3.0): when someone on your team opens a chat ticket in Nukli about an order that was verified with its number and email, Nukli asks your store for the order details (signed endpoint /wp-json/nuklichat/v1/orderdetail): items and prices, totals, shipping address, payment method name and shipment tracking. These details are shown only to your team in the Nukli inbox, never to the chat assistant or to visitors. Your team can then refund (through your payment gateway, if it supports refunds), cancel an order that has not shipped, change its shipping address or resend the order email (signed endpoint /wp-json/nuklichat/v1/orderaction). Each action needs an explicit confirmation by a team member in Nukli, runs only once per request and leaves a private note on the order. The chat assistant cannot run any of these actions.
  • Sales attribution (0.4.0): when a visitor uses the chat, the widget stores a short code signed by Nukli in a first-party cookie (nukli_chat_ref, no personal data, it expires after the attribution window, 7 days by default). If that visitor places an order, the plugin copies the code to the order (private meta _nuklichat_ref). Nukli reads your recent orders through the signed endpoint /wp-json/nuklichat/v1/orders to show you how much the chat sold: order id and number, dates, status, total and currency, the code, and the product and variation ids of the orders that carry it. No names, emails, addresses or payment details are sent.
  • The /wp-json/nuklichat/v1/… and ?rest_route=/nuklichat/v1/… forms are the same endpoint (the second one is used when the store has no pretty permalinks). Without a valid signature the endpoints answer like a route that does not exist.
  • Settings page: when you open Settings › Nukli Chat, your store asks Nukli for the status of your site (connection, number of products indexed, last sync, plan). The “Sync catalog now” button asks Nukli to re-read your catalog. These requests are signed with your site keys and send no customer data; they include your site key, the plugin version and your store address (in the User-Agent).
  • Terms: https://nukliapp.com/terminos — Privacy: https://nukliapp.com/privacidad
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings › Nukli Chat and paste the site key (pk_…) and the secret (sk_…) from your Nukli account.
  3. Tick “Show the chat” and save.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Nukli account? Is it paid?

Yes. The plugin is free, but the chat is provided by Nukli (https://nukliapp.com), a paid service that includes a free trial. You need a Nukli account to get the site key (pk_…) and the secret (sk_…).

What data is sent to Nukli?

Nothing is sent until you save your keys. After that: the chat messages your visitors type, your public catalog (names, descriptions, prices, stock, images) and your public pages, read by Nukli through signed endpoints. For order questions, only the order number and email the visitor typed are checked, and only status, date, total, items and tracking are returned. When your team works on an order from the Nukli inbox, the order details (including the shipping address) are read for your team only. See “External service” above.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Variations are sent with their own options, price, stock and availability, so the assistant can say that a given size is out of stock. Simple, grouped and external products are supported too.

Is it compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility and reads orders only through the WooCommerce order APIs.

How do I disconnect?

Untick “Show the chat” in Settings › Nukli Chat to hide the widget at once, or deactivate the plugin. Deleting the plugin removes its settings from your database. To delete your data on Nukli’s side, do it from your Nukli account.
sections.changelog:
0.4.0

  • Sales attribution: orders placed by visitors who used the chat carry the chat’s code (private order meta), and a signed orders endpoint lets Nukli show how much the chat sold. No personal data is sent.

0.3.1

  • Resending the order email from the Nukli inbox now reports an error when the store cannot send email, instead of saying it was sent.

0.3.0

  • Order actions from the Nukli inbox: signed orderdetail and orderaction endpoints to refund (full, by items or an amount, through the payment gateway), cancel an unshipped order, change the shipping address and resend the order email. Every action is idempotent (the last 20 action keys are kept on the order), locked per order while it runs and leaves a private order note. Works with and without HPOS.
  • The ping endpoint lists the new capabilities.

0.2.0

  • Translations: es_ES, ca, fr_FR, de_DE, it_IT, pt_PT.
  • Order status for the chat: signed order endpoint (order number + email), with Shipment Tracking support. Works with and without HPOS.
  • Settings page shows the status reported by Nukli and has a “Sync catalog now” button.

0.1.0

  • First version: widget, settings page and signed catalog, pages and ping endpoints.
